JavaScript

Category filtering for suggestion cards.

HTML
// Category filter
const cats = document.getElementById('suggest-cats');
const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#suggest-filtered .zak-ai-suggestion-card');
if (cats) {
    cats.querySelectorAll('.zak-ai-suggestion-cat').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            cats.querySelectorAll('.zak-ai-suggestion-cat').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            this.classList.add('active');
            const cat = this.dataset.cat;
            cards.forEach(card => {
                card.style.display = (cat === 'all' || card.dataset.category === cat) ? '' : 'none';
            });
        });
    });
}

// Click suggestion to populate input
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-ai-suggestion-card').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', function() {
        const title = this.querySelector('.zak-ai-suggestion-card-title')?.textContent;
        if (title) console.log('Selected suggestion:', title);
    });
});
